speaker: Leruo
title: The problem
text: On many small farms, watering is guesswork. Too much wastes water and electricity; too little stresses the crop. AgroFlow helps a farmer decide when to irrigate, and how much.

speaker: Olwethu
title: The enquiry
text: Meet Thabo, one of our personas: a tomato farmer near Mafikeng, with one field split into two irrigation zones. He asks for a call back on the AgroFlow website. If he mistypes his phone number, the form tells him straight away.

speaker: Olwethu
title: The call-back
text: Naledi, our second persona, is a field officer. Telegram tells her a new enquiry has arrived. In the Enquiries tab she taps "I'll handle this", so nobody else calls him too. After the call, she logs it: Thabo wants AgroFlow.

speaker: Philisile
title: Onboarding
text: She starts onboarding straight from the enquiry, so Thabo's details are already filled in. She adds his farm and both zones, with crop, soil and size. The enquiry then shows he became a farmer, and the activity log records who did it.

speaker: Philisile
title: Telegram and first sign-in
text: To hand over, Naledi shows a QR code. Thabo scans it and presses Start in the AgroFlow Telegram bot, which sends his sign-in email, a temporary password and the app link. When he first signs in, the app makes him choose his own password.

speaker: Leruo
title: The field kit
text: Next, the field kit: an ESP32 board, a Soil Moisture Sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, and a relay for the pump. Naledi registers the kit to Zone 1 and gets a one-time code. On site, the installer joins the kit's setup Wi-Fi, enters the farm Wi-Fi and the code, and the kit links itself to the zone.
say: Next, the field kit: an E S P thirty-two board, a Soil Moisture Sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor, and a relay for the pump. Naledi registers the kit to Zone 1 and gets a one-time code. On site, the installer joins the kit's setup Wi-Fi, enters the farm Wi-Fi and the code, and the kit links itself to the zone.

speaker: Lubaelihle
title: Zone setup in the app
text: In the app, Thabo finishes each zone's setup. For the flow rate, he times how long his tap takes to fill a 500 millilitre bottle. Then he teaches the sensor his soil, with a wet and a dry reading on different days. With each step, the advice gets surer: from medium to high confidence.
say: In the app, Thabo finishes each zone's setup. For the flow rate, he times how long his tap takes to fill a five hundred millilitre bottle. Then he teaches the sensor his soil, with a wet and a dry reading on different days. With each step, the advice gets surer: from medium to high confidence.

speaker: Lubaelihle
title: Daily use
text: Every day, Home shows one action per zone. Today, Zone 1 needs about 66 minutes of water, or 996 litres, with high confidence. "Why am I seeing this?" shows the reasons: the weather, the crop's stage and the water left in the soil. The week ahead plans each day.
say: Every day, Home shows one action per zone. Today, Zone 1 needs about sixty-six minutes of water, or nine hundred and ninety-six litres, with high confidence. "Why am I seeing this?" shows the reasons: the weather, the crop's stage and the water left in the soil. The week ahead plans each day.

speaker: Leruo
title: Execution
text: AgroFlow recommends; Thabo decides. He starts a run from the app. The command reaches the kit over MQTT, the relay switches the pump on, and the kit reports the run back. For safety, the kit never runs the pump for more than five minutes at a time. Our website demo shows this as a visualisation.
say: AgroFlow recommends; Thabo decides. He starts a run from the app. The command reaches the kit over M Q T T, the relay switches the pump on, and the kit reports the run back. For safety, the kit never runs the pump for more than five minutes at a time. Our website demo shows this as a visualisation.

speaker: Leruo
title: The weather changes
text: Then the forecast changes: 24 millimetres of rain tomorrow. AgroFlow works the plan out again, and Zone 2 no longer needs water on Monday. If rain covers the crop's need, it says wait; if it only helps, it says water less. Thabo also gets a Telegram alert.
say: Then the forecast changes: twenty-four millimetres of rain tomorrow. AgroFlow works the plan out again, and Zone 2 no longer needs water on Monday. If rain covers the crop's need, it says wait; if it only helps, it says water less. Thabo also gets a Telegram alert.

speaker: Olwethu
title: Reports
text: Reports start with what to do next. Thabo makes his as a PDF in the app, and automatic ones arrive on Telegram. Naledi can preview a farm's report, download PDF or Excel, and schedule daily, weekly or monthly reports.

speaker: Olwethu
title: Naledi's admin view
text: For Naledi, Home shows what needs attention across every farm: new requests, quiet kits and farmers without Telegram. Every action is logged, so a small team can look after many farms without losing track.

speaker: Leruo
title: Testing and validation
text: We tested as we built. Forms reject bad input, like a wrong phone number or a run over 60 minutes. In our local test runs on 9 and 10 October, all 1,301 backend tests, all 112 admin tests and all 64 mobile tests passed.

speaker: Leruo
title: Close
text: Every number traces back to its source.

speaker: Philisile
title: Close
say: Built by Team 2 for I N F three thousand and three W.
